chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn 'Umar, from Muhammad ibn 'Uthayfir, from 'Umar ibn Yazid, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Know that when you shave your head, everything becomes permissible for you except women and perfume.
ai.seo_question: What becomes permissible after shaving the head before Tawaf al-Ziyarah in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Istibsar clarifies the sequential legal effects of Halq (shaving) versus Qasr (trimming) in Shia jurisprudence, establishing that shaving the entire head prior to Tawaf al-Ziyarah lifts the prohibition on marital relations and perfume, though it does not complete the full exit from Ihram state. This ruling highlights the scholarly distinction between partial and complete解除 of Ihram restrictions, emphasizing that sexual intimacy remains forbidden until the completion of the specific Tawaf and Sa'i rituals. The hadith serves as a practical guide for pilgrims to understand the precise moment when they may resume normal marital activities during the Hajj or Umrah journey.
